traceability.notes: All functional requirements for Story 026.0 (else-if Prettier compatibility) are implemented: - Else-if annotations are detected in both positions (before `else if` and between condition and body), with explicit fallback and position priority implemented in `gatherElseIfCommentText` and exercised by unit tests. - Auto-fix for else-if branches inserts annotations inside the block body in a Prettier-stable location, validated by targeted tests and supported by `getBranchAnnotationInfo` logic. - The `require-branch-annotation` rule is wired to use this helper via `gatherBranchCommentText` and `reportMissingAnnotations`, and its rule-level tests include a Prettier-style else-if autofix scenario. - An integration test file using real Prettier and ESLint exists and is correctly wired to this story, even though it is skipped by default without a specific env flag. - Documentation for `require-branch-annotation` explicitly describes both valid else-if annotation positions, priority behavior, and Prettier compatibility. All Jest tests in the project pass, and there is no evidence of regressions for other branch types. Therefore, this story is fully implemented and passes.
